name: std::system_category
intro: Obtains a reference to the static error category object for errors reported by the operating system. The object is required to override the virtual function std::error_category::name() to return a pointer to the string "system". It is also required to override the virtual function std::error_category::default_error_condition() to map the error codes that match POSIX errno values to std::generic_category.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the static object of unspecified runtime type, derived from std::error_category.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: On Windows, system_category() typically maps some Windows error codes to POSIX ones. On POSIX, system_category() tends to be equivalent to std::generic_category() except for the name.
